name: 199. Streamed safeguard verdicts survive the message_delta re-render (safeguard-verdict-stream)
description: Claude Code sends safeguards on each request and expects the auto-mode classifier verdicts back as safeguard_results; when they are missing it marks the session ineligible for server-side checks, stops sending safeguards, and shows the 'this session isn't eligible' notice (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/auto-mode-classifier-billing). Bedrock InvokeModel streams the verdicts inside the final message_delta's delta, and Bifrost re-renders every Bedrock stream frame for the /anthropic route (bedrock is not on the raw-passthrough list), so AnthropicStreamDelta lacking a safeguard_results field dropped them: the client saw only stop_reason and stop_sequence. The stream case asserts the verdict survives inside message_delta.delta (red before the fix); the non-streaming case pins the top-level safeguard_results on the unary path, which already worked. The prompt makes the model call the Bash tool, since a verdict is only owed for a tool_use.
